pages.text: Mutandis is the old hedge-breaking powder, scattered over living growth to force a plant into some stranger relation. It is one of the first real ways a witch steps outside ordinary farming and begins coaxing hidden flora into the world.$(br2)It can be compounded by hand from common ingredients, or brewed in the $(item)Witch's Cauldron$() through the older original path.

Compound eight portions from $(item)Wood Ash$(), $(item)Hint of Rebirth$(), a $(item)Mandrake Root$(), an $(item)Egg$(), $(item)Bone Meal$(), and $(item)Green Dye$(). This is the modern layout used by Witchery Resurrected.

pages.title: Cauldron Path
pages.text: The original 1.7.10 Witch's Cauldron path is also available. Fill and heat the $(item)Witch's Cauldron$(), drop a $(item)Mandrake Root$() and an $(item)Egg$() into the water, then right-click with $(item)Exhale of the Horned One$() to produce six portions of Mutandis.$(br2)Similarly, drop $(item)Nether Wart$() into the cauldron and right-click with Mutandis itself to condense one $(item)Mutandis Extremis$(). Both paths are available.

pages.title: Hedge Mutations
pages.text: Use Mutandis directly on natural plants or saplings. In Rewoven today the normal powder can roll Witchery plants and saplings, real placeable $(item)Alder$() and $(item)Hawthorn Saplings$(), vanilla saplings, flowers, fern, short grass, dead bush, and the small vanilla bush shrub. Those Witchery saplings now also count as shared sapling ingredients for broader craft paths like $(item)Wicker Bundles$(), the oven, and sapling-led rites.$(br2)In the Spirit World, the same pool can also reveal Nether Wart.$(br2)It is still a mutating powder, not a fertilizer. Expect transformation, not growth.
Mutandis Extremis is the harsher refinement: surround a $(item)Nether Wart$() with eight ordinary Mutandis to create eight portions. Or use the cauldron path described above.

pages.title: Extremis
pages.text: Extremis pushes the same art further. It can mutate crops as well as wild growth, flip grass and dirt, and turn sand beneath water or ice into clay. It is also the survival bridge into heavier progressions such as Treefyd Seeds and certain stronger brews.$(br2)Treat it as the serious version of hedgecraft, not a casual garden dust.
